title: I go banned

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
>and I hackusate when theirs a fly Hscker. 
That is still illegal, those infractions are valid.

>and it was not 10 infractions in 8 months it's was 10 infractions in 8 months and 4 days. 
It's a guideline we punish by, it's relative to what dates you had, so it's valid. 4 days wouldn't matter.

>id like proof of me swearing and hackusating please 
Evidence is not required for punishments that are not kicks/warns. However, according to our logs, you did indeed swear quite a bit, so therefore it's also valid.


Appeal denied.
